fullText.simplified:
神仙

    很久以前，天上住着神仙，他们神通广大，无所不能。当地上的人类遇到困难，可以向神仙请求保护与帮助。
    中国北方有一座有名的山，名叫华山。华山西边有一个很大的村子，村子里住着很多人。有一年春天，天边飘来几朵黑色的云，村子里下了几场黑色的雨。村子变成了黑色，村子里的人开始生病。这种病很奇怪，会让人全身变黑，然后慢慢死去。
    眼看死去的人越来越多，有人向天上的神仙请求：“请救救我们！”可是一天、两天、三天……时间一天天过去，一个神仙都没有出现。
    村子里有个读书人，叫刘向，他觉得奇怪的病一定和天上的黑云有关系。一天早上，他去爬村里最高的山，想站在山顶把黑云看个清楚。他爬了很久，山上的树和草都被染成了黑色，他看不清路。突然，一只黑色的老虎跳了出来。它张着大嘴，要吃刘向，刘向害怕得差点儿晕过去。就在这时，山顶上突然出现了一团白雾，白雾里站着一个人，居然是个美丽的姑娘。
    姑娘大声说：“不准吃人！”
    老虎大叫一声，向她跑过去。
    刘向担心地对姑娘大喊：“当心！”
    但是很快，刘向的担心就变成了吃惊——这个美丽的姑娘居然和老虎打了起来。
    原来，这老虎不是普通的老虎，姑娘也不是普通的姑娘。他们从山上打到了天上，他们都会飞。打了一会儿后，姑娘拿出了一件东西。
    刘向看清楚了，那是一个红色的像莲花一样的灯。姑娘把灯拿在手里，对着老虎一扬。灯发出强烈的白光，老虎立刻消失不见了。
    姑娘再把灯对着山和村子扬了扬，马上，所有的黑色都不见了，太阳出来了，绿色回来了，山和村子都变回了原来的样子。
    刘向吃惊极了，问姑娘：“你是神仙吗？”
    姑娘笑着说：“对，我是神仙。”
fullText.traditional:
神仙

    很久以前，天上住著神仙，他們神通廣大，無所不能。當地上的人類遇到困難，可以向神仙請求保護與幫助。
    中國北方有一座有名的山，名叫華山。華山西邊有一個很大的村子，村子裡住著很多人。有一年春天，天邊飄來幾朵黑色的雲，村子裡下了幾場黑色的雨。村子變成了黑色，村子裡的人開始生病。這種病很奇怪，會讓人全身變黑，然後慢慢死去。
    眼看死去的人越來越多，有人向天上的神仙請求：“請救救我們！”可是一天、兩天、三天……時間一天天過去，一個神仙都沒有出現。
    村子裡有個讀書人，叫劉向，他覺得奇怪的病一定和天上的黑雲有關係。一天早上，他去爬村裡最高的山，想站在山頂把黑雲看個清楚。他爬了很久，山上的樹和草都被染成了黑色，他看不清路。突然，一隻黑色的老虎跳了出來。它張著大嘴，要吃劉向，劉向害怕得差點兒暈過去。就在這時，山頂上突然出現了一團白霧，白霧裡站著一個人，居然是個美麗的姑娘。
    姑娘大聲說：“不准吃人！”
    老虎大叫一聲，向她跑過去。
    劉向擔心地對姑娘大喊：“當心！”
    但是很快，劉向的擔心就變成了吃驚——這個美麗的姑娘居然和老虎打了起來。
    原來，這老虎不是普通的老虎，姑娘也不是普通的姑娘。他們從山上打到了天上，他們都會飛。打了一會兒後，姑娘拿出了一件東西。
    劉向看清楚了，那是一個紅色的像蓮花一樣的燈。姑娘把燈拿在手裡，對著老虎一揚。燈發出強烈的白光，老虎立刻消失不見了。
    姑娘再把燈對著山和村子揚了揚，馬上，所有的黑色都不見了，太陽出來了，綠色回來了，山和村子都變回了原來的樣子。
    劉向吃驚極了，問姑娘：“你是神仙嗎？”
    姑娘笑著說：“對，我是神仙。”

sentences.simplified: 很久以前，天上住着神仙，他们神通广大，无所不能。
sentences.traditional: 很久以前，天上住著神仙，他們神通廣大，無所不能。
sentences.pinyin: hěn jiǔ yǐ qián tiān shàng zhù zhe shén xiān tā men shén tōng guǎng dà wú suǒ bù néng
sentences.english: A long time ago, immortals lived in the heavens. They possessed remarkable powers. They were omnipotent.

sentences.simplified: 当地上的人类遇到困难，可以向神仙请求保护与帮助。
sentences.traditional: 當地上的人類遇到困難，可以向神仙請求保護與幫助。
sentences.pinyin: dāng dì shang de rén lèi yù dào kùn nan kě yǐ xiàng shén xiān qǐng qiú bǎo hù yǔ bāng zhù
sentences.english: When human beings encountered difficulties on earth, they could ask the immortals for protection and help.

sentences.simplified: 中国北方有一座有名的山，名叫华山。
sentences.traditional: 中國北方有一座有名的山，名叫華山。
sentences.pinyin: zhōng guó běi fāng yǒu yí zuò yǒu míng de shān míng jiào huà shān
sentences.english: There is a famous mountain in northern China called Mount Hua.

sentences.simplified: 华山西边有一个很大的村子，村子里住着很多人。
sentences.traditional: 華山西邊有一個很大的村子，村子裡住著很多人。
sentences.pinyin: huà shān xī biān yǒu yí ge hěn dà de cūn zi cūn zi lǐ zhù zhe hěn duō rén
sentences.english: There was a big village west of Mount Hua. Many people lived in the village.

sentences.simplified: 有一年春天，天边飘来几朵黑色的云，村子里下了几场黑色的雨。
sentences.traditional: 有一年春天，天邊飄來幾朵黑色的雲，村子裡下了幾場黑色的雨。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu yì nián chūn tiān tiān biān piāo lái jǐ duǒ hēi sè de yún cūn zi lǐ xià le jǐ cháng hēi sè de yǔ
sentences.english: One spring, some black clouds came floating in the sky, and black rain fell in the village.

sentences.simplified: 村子变成了黑色，村子里的人开始生病。
sentences.traditional: 村子變成了黑色，村子裡的人開始生病。
sentences.pinyin: cūn zi biàn chéng le hēi sè cūn zi lǐ de rén kāi shǐ shēng bìng
sentences.english: The village turned black and the people in the village started to get sick.

sentences.simplified: 这种病很奇怪，会让人全身变黑，然后慢慢死去。
sentences.traditional: 這種病很奇怪，會讓人全身變黑，然後慢慢死去。
sentences.pinyin: zhè zhǒng bìng hěn qí guài huì ràng rén quán shēn biàn hēi rán hòu màn man sǐ qù
sentences.english: This disease was very strange. It made people turn black all over and then slowly die.

sentences.simplified: 眼看死去的人越来越多，有人向天上的神仙请求：“请救救我们！”
sentences.traditional: 眼看死去的人越來越多，有人向天上的神仙請求：“請救救我們！”
sentences.pinyin: yǎn kàn sǐ qù de rén yuè lái yuè duō yǒu rén xiàng tiān shàng de shén xiān qǐng qiú qǐng jiù jiù wǒ men
sentences.english: Seeing more and more people die, some people beseeched the immortals in the heavens: “Please save us!”

sentences.simplified: 可是一天、两天、三天……时间一天天过去，一个神仙都没有出现。
sentences.traditional: 可是一天、兩天、三天……時間一天天過去，一個神仙都沒有出現。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì yì tiān liǎng tiān sān tiān shí jiān yì tiān tiān guò qù yí ge shén xiān dōu méi yǒu chū xiàn
sentences.english: But one day, two days, three days … time passed day by day, and not one immortal appeared.

sentences.simplified: 村子里有个读书人，叫刘向，
sentences.traditional: 村子裡有個讀書人，叫劉向，
sentences.pinyin: cūn zi lǐ yǒu ge dú shū rén jiào liú xiàng
sentences.english: There was a scholar in the village named Liu Xiang.

sentences.simplified: 他觉得奇怪的病一定和天上的黑云有关系。
sentences.traditional: 他覺得奇怪的病一定和天上的黑雲有關係。
sentences.pinyin: tā jué de qí guài de bìng yí dìng hé tiān shàng de hēi yún yǒu guān xi
sentences.english: He thought that the strange illness must have something to do with the black clouds in the sky.

sentences.simplified: 一天早上，他去爬村里最高的山，
sentences.traditional: 一天早上，他去爬村裡最高的山，
sentences.pinyin: yì tiān zǎo shang tā qù pá cūn lǐ zuì gāo de shān
sentences.english: One morning, he went to climb the highest mountain in the village.

sentences.simplified: 想站在山顶把黑云看个清楚。
sentences.traditional: 想站在山頂把黑雲看個清楚。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎng zhàn zài shān dǐng bǎ hēi yún kàn ge qīng chu
sentences.english: He wanted to stand on the summit to see the black clouds clearly.

sentences.simplified: 他爬了很久，山上的树和草都被染成了黑色，他看不清路。
sentences.traditional: 他爬了很久，山上的樹和草都被染成了黑色，他看不清路。
sentences.pinyin: tā pá le hěn jiǔ shān shang de shù hé cǎo dōu bèi rǎn chéng le hēi sè tā kàn bù qīng lù
sentences.english: He climbed for a long time. The trees and grass on the mountain were all dyed black, and he couldn’t see the path.

sentences.simplified: 突然，一只黑色的老虎跳了出来。
sentences.traditional: 突然，一隻黑色的老虎跳了出來。
sentences.pinyin: tū rán yì zhī hēi sè de lǎo hǔ tiào le chu lai
sentences.english: Suddenly, a black tiger jumped out.

sentences.simplified: 它张着大嘴，要吃刘向，刘向害怕得差点儿晕过去。
sentences.traditional: 它張著大嘴，要吃劉向，劉向害怕得差點兒暈過去。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhāng zhe dà zuǐ yào chī liú xiàng liú xiàng hài pà de chà diǎn'r yūn guò qù
sentences.english: It opened its big mouth and wanted to eat Liu Xiang. Liu Xiang was so scared that he almost passed out.

sentences.simplified: 就在这时，山顶上突然出现了一团白雾，
sentences.traditional: 就在這時，山頂上突然出現了一團白霧，
sentences.pinyin: jiù zài zhè shí shān dǐng shang tū rán chū xiàn le yì tuán bái wù
sentences.english: Just then, a white mist suddenly appeared on the top of the mountain.

sentences.simplified: 白雾里站着一个人，居然是个美丽的姑娘。
sentences.traditional: 白霧裡站著一個人，居然是個美麗的姑娘。
sentences.pinyin: bái wù lǐ zhàn zhe yí ge rén jū rán shì ge měi lì de gū niang
sentences.english: Someone was standing in the white mist. It turned out to be a beautiful girl.

sentences.simplified: 姑娘大声说：“不准吃人！”
sentences.traditional: 姑娘大聲說：“不准吃人！”
sentences.pinyin: gū niang dà shēng shuō bù zhǔn chī rén
sentences.english: The girl shouted, “You may not eat him!”

sentences.simplified: 老虎大叫一声，向她跑过去。
sentences.traditional: 老虎大叫一聲，向她跑過去。
sentences.pinyin: lǎo hǔ dà jiào yì shēng xiàng tā pǎo guò qu
sentences.english: The tiger roared and ran towards her.

sentences.simplified: 刘向担心地对姑娘大喊：“当心！”
sentences.traditional: 劉向擔心地對姑娘大喊：“當心！”
sentences.pinyin: liú xiàng dān xīn de duì gū niang dà hǎn dāng xīn
sentences.english: Liu Xiang was worried and shouted to the girl: “Watch out!”

sentences.simplified: 但是很快，刘向的担心就变成了吃惊——这个美丽的姑娘居然和老虎打了起来。
sentences.traditional: 但是很快，劉向的擔心就變成了吃驚——這個美麗的姑娘居然和老虎打了起來。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì hěn kuài liú xiàng de dān xīn jiù biàn chéng le chī jīng zhè ge měi lì de gū niang jū rán hé lǎo hǔ dǎ le qǐ lái
sentences.english: But soon, Liu Xiang’s worry turned to amazement—this beautiful girl actually started fighting the tiger.

sentences.simplified: 原来，这老虎不是普通的老虎，姑娘也不是普通的姑娘。
sentences.traditional: 原來，這老虎不是普通的老虎，姑娘也不是普通的姑娘。
sentences.pinyin: yuán lái zhè lǎo hǔ bú shì pǔ tōng de lǎo hǔ gū niang yě bú shì pǔ tōng de gū niang
sentences.english: It turned out that the tiger was no ordinary tiger, and the girl was no ordinary girl.

sentences.simplified: 他们从山上打到了天上，他们都会飞。打了一会儿后，姑娘拿出了一件东西。
sentences.traditional: 他們從山上打到了天上，他們都會飛。打了一會兒後，姑娘拿出了一件東西。
sentences.pinyin: tā men cóng shān shang dǎ dào le tiān shàng tā men dōu huì fēi dǎ le yí huì'r hòu gū niang ná chū le yí jiàn dōng xi
sentences.english: They fought from the mountain to the sky. They could both fly. After fighting for a while, the girl took out something.

sentences.simplified: 刘向看清楚了，那是一个红色的像莲花一样的灯。
sentences.traditional: 劉向看清楚了，那是一個紅色的像蓮花一樣的燈。
sentences.pinyin: liú xiàng kàn qīng chu le nà shì yí ge hóng sè de xiàng lián huā yí yàng de dēng
sentences.english: Liu Xiang clearly saw that it was a lamp that looked like a red lotus flower.

sentences.simplified: 姑娘把灯拿在手里，对着老虎一扬。
sentences.traditional: 姑娘把燈拿在手裡，對著老虎一揚。
sentences.pinyin: gū niang bǎ dēng ná zài shǒu lǐ duì zhe lǎo hǔ yì yáng
sentences.english: The girl took the lamp in her hand and raised it towards the tiger.

sentences.simplified: 灯发出强烈的白光，老虎立刻消失不见了。
sentences.traditional: 燈發出強烈的白光，老虎立刻消失不見了。
sentences.pinyin: dēng fā chū qiáng liè de bái guāng lǎo hǔ lì kè xiāo shī bú jiàn le
sentences.english: The lamp emitted a strong white light, and the tiger immediately disappeared.

sentences.simplified: 姑娘再把灯对着山和村子扬了扬，
sentences.traditional: 姑娘再把燈對著山和村子揚了揚，
sentences.pinyin: gū niang zài bǎ dēng duì zhe shān hé cūn zi yáng le yáng
sentences.english: The girl then raised the lamp towards the mountain and the village.

sentences.simplified: 马上，所有的黑色都不见了，太阳出来了，绿色回来了，
sentences.traditional: 馬上，所有的黑色都不見了，太陽出來了，綠色回來了，
sentences.pinyin: mǎ shàng suǒ yǒu de hēi sè dōu bú jiàn le tài yáng chū lái le lǜ sè huí lái le
sentences.english: Immediately, all the black was gone, the sun came out, and the green came back.

sentences.simplified: 山和村子都变回了原来的样子。
sentences.traditional: 山和村子都變回了原來的樣子。
sentences.pinyin: shān hé cūn zi dōu biàn huí le yuán lái de yàng zi
sentences.english: The mountain and the village were changed back to their original appearance.

sentences.simplified: 刘向吃惊极了，问姑娘：“你是神仙吗？”
sentences.traditional: 劉向吃驚極了，問姑娘：“你是神仙嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: liú xiàng chī jīng jí le wèn gū niang nǐ shì shén xiān ma
sentences.english: Liu Xiang was amazed and asked the girl, “Are you an immortal?”

sentences.simplified: 姑娘笑着说：“对，我是神仙。”
sentences.traditional: 姑娘笑著說：“對，我是神仙。”
sentences.pinyin: gū niang xiào zhe shuō duì wǒ shì shén xiān
sentences.english: The girl smiled and said, “Yes, I am an immortal.”

sentence_translations: The Immortal
A long time ago, immortals lived in the heavens. They possessed remarkable powers. They were omnipotent.
When human beings encountered difficulties on earth, they could ask the immortals for protection and help.
There is a famous mountain in northern China called Mount Hua.
There was a big village west of Mount Hua. Many people lived in the village.
One spring, some black clouds came floating in the sky, and black rain fell in the village.
The village turned black and the people in the village started to get sick.
This disease was very strange. It made people turn black all over and then slowly die.
Seeing more and more people die, some people beseeched the immortals in the heavens: “Please save us!”
But one day, two days, three days … time passed day by day, and not one immortal appeared.
There was a scholar in the village named Liu Xiang.
He thought that the strange illness must have something to do with the black clouds in the sky.
One morning, he went to climb the highest mountain in the village.
He wanted to stand on the summit to see the black clouds clearly.
He climbed for a long time. The trees and grass on the mountain were all dyed black, and he couldn’t see the path.
Suddenly, a black tiger jumped out.
It opened its big mouth and wanted to eat Liu Xiang. Liu Xiang was so scared that he almost passed out.
Just then, a white mist suddenly appeared on the top of the mountain.
Someone was standing in the white mist. It turned out to be a beautiful girl.
The girl shouted, “You may not eat him!”
The tiger roared and ran towards her.
Liu Xiang was worried and shouted to the girl: “Watch out!”
But soon, Liu Xiang’s worry turned to amazement—this beautiful girl actually started fighting the tiger.
It turned out that the tiger was no ordinary tiger, and the girl was no ordinary girl.
They fought from the mountain to the sky. They could both fly. After fighting for a while, the girl took out something.
Liu Xiang clearly saw that it was a lamp that looked like a red lotus flower.
The girl took the lamp in her hand and raised it towards the tiger.
The lamp emitted a strong white light, and the tiger immediately disappeared.
The girl then raised the lamp towards the mountain and the village.
Immediately, all the black was gone, the sun came out, and the green came back.
The mountain and the village were changed back to their original appearance.
Liu Xiang was amazed and asked the girl, “Are you an immortal?”
The girl smiled and said, “Yes, I am an immortal.”
